:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-maximum}
#### Check the critical point is a maximum

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle,
use the [second derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-second-derivative) from @exr-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative to verify that the [critical point](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-critical-point) $\hat\pmean_{ML}$ from @exr-prac-exp-mle-mle is a maximum.

:::
